column3: It directly commands the Prophet to worship Allah with religion made sincere for Him alone.
It names Joseph's brothers as ignorant, offering only a broad characterization of the addressees in the focus.
Wrongdoing done in ignorance and followed by repentance gives a general moral frame for ignorance, not rival worship.
The same surah declares that the Prophet worships Allah alone with sincere devotion.
The immediately following warning makes association with Allah the direct forbidden alternative to the focus's exclusive worship.
Noah commands his people to worship none but Allah, directly matching the focus's rejection of other objects of worship.
It explicitly rejects worshipping what others worship besides Allah and affirms worship of Allah alone.
The immediate continuation answers the focus's question with a command to worship Allah and give thanks.
It treats evil committed in ignorance and later repair, but does not address whom one worships.
